frame.originDescription: Synthetic bridge datum at chest centre; +x right, +y up; mm.

calibrations.description: Inspector-derived provisional calibration "CAL-SYN-B1" version "v1"; uniform scale 10 mm per model unit over 1 measurement(s) (max residual 0 mm); pending human review; never production-approved.

limitations: Uniform isotropic scale only: a single anchor-pair distance cannot establish anisotropy, shear, or rotation; directional distortion is undetectable by this kernel.
Result is provisional and pending human review; this kernel never production-approves a calibration.
Bridge output is a provisional prepared definition; not production-approved and pending human review.
Planar-only mapping: region geometry applies to the authored planar frame in millimetres.
Curved/3D surface mapping is out of scope: this bridge carries no mesh, UV, or deformation data; downstream placements apply to the planar frame, not to a 3D garment surface.
Uniform isotropic scale only: a single anchor-pair distance cannot establish anisotropy, shear, or rotation.

All listed variants share one inspector calibration derived from evidence product "SYN-BRIDGE" variant "SYN-BRIDGE-V1"; variants are setup groupings, not independently measured calibrations. Independent physical calibration per variant remains unvalidated.
Product carries no logos: 0..N logos attach downstream by logoId/regionId; the product only constrains placement frames.
